tests.name: 4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立
tests.assertion:
test('4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立',()=>{for(const weak of[false,true]){const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true}),b=prepared({move:38338});const move=a.moveDefinitions[key(10716)],plain=b.moveDefinitions[key(10716)];if(weak){move.type='光';plain.type='光';}turn(a,38338,10716);turn(b,38338,10716);const hits=s=>s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);const ar=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='attack'),br=hits(b).find(e=>e.type==='attack');if(weak)assert.equal(ar.settledDamage,br.settledDamage);else{assert.ok(ar.settledDamage>=Math.floor(br.settledDamage*.7)-1);assert.ok(ar.settledDamage<=Math.ceil(br.settledDamage*.7)+1);}const fixed=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(fixed.settledDamage,weak?35:50);}
 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

tests.name: 4888真实2075回初有异改清敌能力提升，成功疲惫，强化保护或没有提升不触发，回初快照后新异不切换减伤

tests.assertion:
test('4888真实2075登场公共异常链也观察对方进入附属；异常清除后再次进入算新事件，首个未打开按门序而非已开数量',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.a,'星赐',2,c.a);}};let s;try{s=make({move:38338,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gateEvents[0].round,1);
 const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[1];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.clearAilments(c.a);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(a));assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[1,0,2]);});
